column1: # Synthetic KITE as-of replay negative-control manifest v0.1
# All timestamps are integer seconds from a synthetic episode origin; no value is real port data.
# Visibility is based on first availability, not event occurrence. Ingestion and validation are separate gates.
# authority_state_at_cutoff preserves historical knowledge; authority_state_current may change later.
# current_authority_available_at_s records when a later authority state became knowable.
# OBSERVED, CENSORED, CONFLICT and DUPLICATE are distinct evidence states. UNKNOWN is never zero.
# Action execution additionally requires action_requested=YES, a valid as-of authority/rights state,
# timely plan publication, authorization by cutoff, and publication before the service deadline.
